text:
alex: quick question — whats the one thing you always grab before leaving the house? keys, coffee, or your brain? :thinking:

sam: keys. if i don't have keys, i turn around 97% of the time :key:

jamie: phone + chapstick. chapstick is nonnegotiable :lipstick:

maria: reusable water bottle. also a mug if i'm driving :recycle:

nina: headphones. music calms my commute :headphones:

alex: @maria i've seen your mug collection. priorities. :laughing:

sam: small PSA: check pockets for snacks. saved me from hangry today :salute:

jamie: also, wallet. had a friend who left it once and we spent 2 hrs retracing steps :grimacing:

infra-bot: Reminder: office doors lock at 7pm — if you're staying late, bring your badge :lock:

maria: ooh badge + metro card. double-checking those is my pre-exit ritual.

nina: curiosity: who actually brings a physical umbrella regularly? :umbrella:

alex: i do if the forecast says "maybe". otherwise i forget and become very wet :sweat_smile:

sam: consensus: keys, phone, wallet, and one tiny comfort item (chapstick/headphones) :thumbsup:

jamie: poll it is — who votes "reusable bottle" as number one? raise hands :hand:

maria: raising both hands. :raised_hands:

alex: thanks folks. tiny rituals save the day. going to add "check keys" sticky note on my door :memo:
